'''Southern Mustafarians''' were one of the two [[subspecies]] of [[Mustafarian]]s which evolved separately in underground caves. They worked together to collect valuable [[mineral]]s from the [[Magma|lava]] flow and had a trade agreement with the [[Techno Union]]. Southern Mustafarians were stockier and stronger as well had more resistance against heat.<ref name="CE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> They were burly and short, measuring 1.5 [[meter]]s, and performed all physical tasks.<ref name="Absolutely Everything You Need to Know" /> They had tough, [[blaster]]-resistant skin, but still required protective [[armor]] to work near the lava of their [[Volcano|volcanic]] habitat.<ref name="VE" /> Southern Mustafarians lived in groups known as clanholds. [[Father (title)|Father]] [[Kkkt]], who also happened to be [[Force-sensitive]], led one [[Kkkt's clan|such clan]]. When Mustafar was rocked by the construction of [[Fortress Vader]], Kkkt made contact with other clanholds and led an army to [[Battle of Fortress Vader|attack the castle]].<ref name="Dark Lord 23">[[Darth Vader (2017) 23|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 23]]</ref>
